primary_title: A 156-kDa dystrophin-associated glycoprotein is a member of the syntrophin family
decision_basis: The beta-dystroglycan cytoplasmic PPXY region associates with dystrophin in muscle and brain cytoskeletal anchoring systems
limitations_preserved: Promote beta-dystroglycan PPXY cytoskeletal anchoring only; preserve beta- rather than alpha-dystroglycan topology and muscle/brain comparator context, with no SCI inference.

primary_title: A dystrophin-associated protein, beta-dystroglycan, binds Grb2
decision_basis: The beta-dystroglycan C-terminal tail binds Grb2 through an adaptor-recognition motif in biochemical and cell-associated assays
limitations_preserved: Promote direct beta-dystroglycan-tail/Grb2 adaptor binding only; preserve dystroglycan cytoplasmic-tail and muscle/brain context without a generalized receptor relay or SCI claim.

primary_title: Caveolin-3 binds dystrophin and is associated with the dystrophin-glycoprotein complex
decision_basis: The beta-dystroglycan PPXY region associates with caveolin-3 in muscle membrane complexes and competes with dystrophin binding
limitations_preserved: Promote the beta-dystroglycan PPXY/caveolin-3 scaffold association only; preserve muscle-specific competition with dystrophin and no autonomous signaling or SCI inference.

primary_title: Syndecan-4 cytoplasmic domain binds and activates protein kinase C-alpha
decision_basis: The syndecan-4 cytoplasmic V-region binds and activates PKC-alpha in a PIP2/oligomeric context and supports adhesion signaling
limitations_preserved: Promote the PIP2- and oligomerization-dependent syndecan-4/PKC-alpha branch only; preserve cytoplasmic adhesion context and no autonomous integrin or SCI inference.

decision_basis: The syndecan-4 cytoplasmic domain directly associates with alpha-actinin in biochemical and Sdc4-null fibroblast rescue systems
limitations_preserved: Promote direct syndecan-4 cytoplasmic-domain/alpha-actinin association only; preserve cytoskeletal context and no autonomous integrin relay or SCI inference.

primary_title: Syndecan-4 binds syntenin-1 at its C-terminal EFYA motif
decision_basis: The syndecan C-terminal EFYA motif binds syntenin-1 PDZ domains in yeast two-hybrid, blot-overlay and SPR assays, including syndecan-4 family context
limitations_preserved: Promote direct SDC4 EFYA/syntenin-1 PDZ binding with family-wide motif caveat; do not infer a specific growth-factor relay or SCI effect.

primary_title: Syndecan-4 cytoplasmic domain interacts with syntenin and synectin
decision_basis: The syndecan-4 cytoplasmic domain associates with GIPC/synectin and contributes to migration in receptor-domain and ECV304 cell assays
limitations_preserved: Promote the syndecan-4/GIPC1 association with bounded migration support only; preserve adaptor-context semantics and no direct growth-factor receptor or SCI inference.

primary_title: Structural basis for the integrin beta3 cytoplasmic tail interaction with Dok1
decision_basis: The phosphorylated beta3-integrin Y747 tail motif binds the Dok1 PTB domain in NMR/HSQC titrations, defining a phosphosite-sensitive integrin activation switch
limitations_preserved: Promote direct phosphosite docking only; preserve beta3 numbering, phosphorylation state and recombinant-domain limits, without a universal integrin activation or SCI claim.

primary_title: The integrin beta3 cytoplasmic domain binds the talin head domain
decision_basis: Talin-1 FERM-domain fragments bind the beta3 NPLY-containing cytoplasmic tail in structural, NMR and mutational assays and support integrin activation
limitations_preserved: Promote direct beta3-tail/talin-1 binding and activation-compatible layer only; preserve unphosphorylated NPLY motif and engineered-fragment context, with no SCI inference.

primary_title: The juxtamembrane domain of E-cadherin binds p120ctn
decision_basis: E-cadherin juxtamembrane-domain mutants lose p120-catenin association, establishing direct cadherin-tail recruitment and adhesion stability control
limitations_preserved: Promote direct E-cadherin juxtamembrane/p120-catenin recruitment and stability only; preserve epithelial context and no direct E-cadherin-alpha-catenin inference.

primary_title: Identification of a 25-amino acid sequence in the cadherin cytoplasmic domain that binds beta-catenin
decision_basis: The E-cadherin catenin-binding domain directly binds beta-catenin in yeast two-hybrid and recombinant mapping assays, forming the cadherin scaffold
limitations_preserved: Promote direct E-cadherin/beta-catenin scaffold assembly only; preserve that beta-catenin links onward to alpha-catenin and do not encode a direct CDH1-alpha-catenin edge.

primary_title: The juxtamembrane domain of VE-cadherin is essential for endothelial cell-cell adhesion
decision_basis: VE-cadherin juxtamembrane deletion and rescue studies support direct p120-catenin association with endothelial adhesion and proliferation phenotypes
limitations_preserved: Promote VE-cadherin juxtamembrane/p120 association in the endothelial adhesion layer; preserve cell-context boundaries and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.
